85-classfile-method-signature-types:
program ServerApp {
  type: Program
  entry: ServerFile
  version: 1.0.0
  exports: [runServer]
}

ServerFile @ src/server.ts:
  <- [LeaseStore, Lease]
  -> [runServer]

classfile LeaseStore {
  type: ClassFile
  path: src/store.ts
  method: "allocate(worktreePath: string) => Lease | AllocationFailure"
  method: "list() => readonly Lease[]"
  constructor: "(config: StoreConfig, leases?: Lease[])"
  exports: [Lease, StoreConfig, AllocationFailure, LeaseStore]
}

runServer :: runServer() => readonly Lease[]

Lease %
  - id: string
  - portBase: number

StoreConfig %
  - rangeBase: number
  - rangeCount: number

AllocationFailure %
  - kind: 'no_capacity'
